# X-Factor Peptides

> **Disclaimer**: All products sold by X-Factor Peptides are intended strictly for laboratory and research use only. They are not for human consumption, diagnostic, therapeutic, or any agricultural or veterinary purposes.

## About Us
X-Factor Peptides is a premier US-based supplier of high-quality, research-grade peptides for laboratory and scientific use. We pride ourselves on providing the highest purity compounds (typically >99.0% purity) and exceptional customer service. 

## Products
We provide lyophilized peptide powders including, but not limited to:
- BPC-157
- Semaglutide
- Tirzepatide
- TB-500
- NAD+
- Retatrutide

## Policies & Shipping
- Fast shipping within the USA.
- Support available via WhatsApp and email.
- Due to the nature of research chemicals, we do not accept returns. All sales are final.
